responsive.rule: breakpoints are based on owning container width; browser/device names are never semantic inputs

collections.rule: collections use deterministic server keyset pages; Beta 1.0 does not accumulate unbounded infinite-scroll DOM

autocomplete.rule: focus alone does not enumerate; explicit disclosure may request the first bounded eligible page

no_silent_truncation_rule: When a bound is reached, UI exposes partial/additional-results/capacity state; it never silently drops selected IDs, warnings, dirty fields or accepted result rows.
